# Acceptance Criteria

## AC-1.1

WHEN the externally observable public API catalog exposes a contractVersion, renderable UI input schema, and omits internal runtime detail THEN the deployed response contract is stable and redacted.

## AC-1.2

WHEN a costly production paid execution is requested THEN authentication, balance admission, funded dispatch, idempotent settlement, and artifact readback are proven live.
